title: Adaptive score measurements in decoded quantum interferometry on planted polynomial lists
description: For random balanced lists over a finite field at q = k^4, polynomially many standard decoded quantum interferometry score measurements reveal negligible information about whether a degree-below-k polynomial was planted. We prove a total-variation bound for the complete adaptive score transcript on a single reused table, uniformly in the fixed plant. A separate estimate gives the exact optimal one-shot probability of measuring a specified perfect fit. The comparison covers scores returned from fresh ideal preparations and does not establish hardness for algorithms that inspect the written table.
